subject.title: WhatsApp: support pre-built link previews in sendMessage + batch send RPC method

question: Which scope should OpenClaw accept for this issue: staged pre-built WhatsApp `linkPreview` pass-through only, full automatic-preview plus batch Gateway design, or no core change?
rationale: The pass-through is dependency-supported and narrow, but automatic URL fetching and a new batch RPC are security/protocol choices that source inspection cannot settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Stage pass-through first
options.body: Implement the typed pre-built WhatsApp `linkPreview` pass-through now and leave automatic fetching plus batch RPC for separate maintainer-reviewed designs.

options.title: Design the full scope
options.body: Keep all three capabilities together and require a broader security/protocol design before implementation.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Reject core changes and leave preview prefetching or bulk notification workflows to custom scripts or future plugin/API discussions.

recommendation.title: Stage pass-through first
recommendation.body: Implement the typed pre-built WhatsApp `linkPreview` pass-through now and leave automatic fetching plus batch RPC for separate maintainer-reviewed designs.

likelyOwner.reason: He already consolidated the narrower WhatsApp link-preview report into this broader tracker and has the strongest product-routing signal in the related history.
